tasha_cs: QuartzBeam reported intermittent 502/504s from EU during a partner demo at 09:20 UTC. They asked whether we can route demo traffic to an EU edge and grant a short-lived qps uplift. Renewal cadence in ~2 weeks, pulling this into renewal notes.

owen_se: Which endpoints and traffic shape?

tasha_cs: Mostly /v1/generate and chat stream. They saw ~95 rps sustained for ~9m with bursts to ~230 rps. They requested eu-edge + x1.9 qps for a 24h demo window starting today 11:00 UTC.

mina_netops: We can enable eu-west-3-edge and add their CIDR ranges to the allowlist. Need CIDRs and formal window. Recommend short TTL auto-revoke after 24h.

tasha_cs: CIDRs provided: 51.77.120.0/22 and 198.18.0.64/26. Window 11:00 -> +24h.

mina_netops: Creating ACL entry "quartz-demo-5467" -> acl-12455 and will apply to eu-west-3-edge with revoke at +24h.

owen_se: I'll push a per-route QPS override on their API token route (x1.9) and pin to burst pool to limit blast radius.

leo_infra: I'll provision a tiny burst node group in eu-west-3 (1x A10g equiv) tagged quartz-burst-5467. Opening INC-4777 and tagging eng-sre for monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-4777 "QuartzBeam EU demo: edge allowlist + temp qps override" by leo_infra. ETA: 55m.

tasha_cs: Please add renewal note: client said demo perf will affect renewal. Marking renewal_risk: medium-high.

mina_netops: ACL applied (acl-12455). Please confirm customer test.

tasha_cs: Sent curl example and scheduled smoke at 11:05 UTC.

tasha_cs: curl sample:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $QUARTZ_DEMO" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-stream","input":"smoke"}'
```

owen_se: Monitoring traces and token latency; fallback plan is hosted-eu-replica and conservative throttle if errors persist.

leo_infra: Burst nodes up, qps override pushed, auto-revoke scheduled +24h. Closing loop after post-demo report. :white_check_mark:

tasha_cs: Thanks — will collect feedback and update renewal tracker + add notes to onboarding playbook.
